question: runs.tsv says PAIRED but ENA lists a single FASTQ per run (SRRxxxx.fastq.gz, no _1/_2), and n_bases / n_spots = 2 x read length (150 for the 75 bp tissue libraries, 100 for the 50 bp LCM libraries). How are the mates stored?
proposed_answer: Probably both mates in one file (interleaved or concatenated). The M3 downloader and quantifier must check the layout of one file before processing; not resolved here.
evidence: runs.tsv: library_layout PAIRED, one fastq_urls entry, read_length 75 (80 tissue runs) and 50 (80 LCM runs), n_bases/n_spots exactly 150 or 100.

question: The regime is 16 h at 16 °C (day, T1) then 8 h at 12 °C (night, T2); control 26 then 18 °C. The BioSample temp attribute gives the temperature at sampling (T1 16/26, T2 12/18). Which goes in temperature_C?
proposed_answer: Following the spec (day value when day and night differ): temperature_C = 16 (cold) / 26 (control) and temperature_night_C = 12 / 18 for every sample, control_temperature_C = 26, so T1 and T2 differ only in time_h (16 vs 24 h cumulative cold). The temperature at sampling is in curation_note. If contrasts should use the sampling temperature instead, T2 would be 12 vs 18.
evidence: Results and Fig. 1A legend: "time point T1 refers to growth for 16 h at 16 °C, and T2 for an add-on period of 8 h at 12 °C"; Methods: control 26/18 °C, 16 h light/8 h dark.

question: For LCM libraries the number in the title (CD1-CD5, CT1-CT8) is not the replicate (e.g. T1-CD2-en is replicate 2, T1-CD2-ep replicate 1). Which to use?
proposed_answer: The BioSample "biological replicate" attribute (rep1-rep4), which gives exactly four replicates per tissue/cell type, condition and time point (verified for all 40 groups). Title numbers look like a plate or sample-set index.
evidence: Run list: every group of tissue x condition x time point has replicates 1-4 once; title numbers repeat across cell types.

question: The titles use PR, MZ, EZ, CO, St (bulk, underscore titles) and co, en, ep, pp, xp (LCM, hyphen titles). The mapping to the paper's sample types was inferred. Correct?
proposed_answer: Bulk: PR = whole primary root (organ level), MZ = meristematic zone (apical 2 mm), EZ = elongation zone, CO = Co_T (epidermis + cortical parenchyma + endodermis of the differentiation zone), St = stele, matching the BioSample tissue text (primary root, meristematic zone, elongation zone, cortex, stele). LCM: ep epidermis, co cortex, en endodermis, pp phloem-pole pericycle, xp xylem-pole pericycle (BioSample tissue). CD = cold and CT = control (BioSample treatment). Table S6 (listed in the paper as primers) was not needed. Do not pool Co_T with LCM cortex: Co_T contains epidermis and endodermis.
evidence: Methods and Fig. 1 legend on the OUP page; BioSample tissue and treatment attributes for all 160 runs.

item: Root hairs and mutants not sequenced
question: The catalogue lists root hairs and the rth5, rth6, dreb2.1 and DREB2.1-overexpression lines, but the BioProject has only PE0075 libraries. Are there other transcriptome datasets?
proposed_answer: No root-hair or mutant RNA-seq is in PRJNA852372 (160 PE0075 runs: 5 tissues + 5 cell types x 4 replicates x 2 conditions x 2 time points). Root hairs and mutants/B73 were analysed by RT-qPCR and phenotyping only, so no rows for them.
evidence: OUP page: "Root hairs of primary roots were used for expression analyses" (Fig. 4, RT-qPCR); RNA-seq described for whole primary roots, four tissues and five cell types, PE0075 only.

item: Time of harvest and cold onset
question: The paper does not give clock times. Was cold applied at the start of the light period, and were T2 samples harvested in the dark?
proposed_answer: time_h = 16 (T1) and 24 (T2) from cold onset, assumed at the start of treatment (4 d after germination). T1 follows the 16 h day phase and T2 the following 8 h night phase, so T2 was harvested at the end of the dark period; recorded in light_condition. Controls were harvested at the same times (time-matched).
evidence: Methods: "The first sampling (time point 1) was carried out after 16 h of growth at 26 °C (control) or 16 °C (cold)" and "The second sampling (time point 2) was carried out after another 8 h of growth".

question: BioSample age is 5 days for all samples, but the paper says treatment started 4 d after germination (so T1 ~4.7 d and T2 ~5 d after germination).
proposed_answer: age_days = 5 for all (BioSample value, first source in the spec); the paper value is in the stage text.
evidence: Methods: "Four days after germination in paper rolls under control conditions ... seedlings were subsequently subjected to control or cold treatment"; BioSample attribute age "5 days".

item: Pooling for LCM samples and quality
question: The number of cells or seedlings per LCM sample is not reported, and RNA quality of LCM libraries is lower (RIN 5.5-7.2 vs >= 8 for bulk tissues). Include all?
proposed_answer: Include all 80 LCM libraries (pooled_plants left empty); the 50 bp reads and low-input RNA may give noisier libraries, to be judged by library QC in M3/M4, not here.
evidence: Methods: cell-type RNA with PicoPure kit, RIN 5.5-7.2, 2.9-18.8 ng/µl; bulk RNA RIN >= 8.

question: The LCM sections were taken 1.75-2.25 mm from the root tip, but Mz is defined as the apical 2 mm. Should LCM cell types be treated as part of the meristematic/transition zone?
proposed_answer: tissue_detail says "meristematic-zone cross sections 1.75-2.25 mm from root tip" as in the Fig. 1 legend ("5 root cell types of the meristematic zone"). Contrasts should only compare each cell type with its own control, not with bulk zones.
evidence: Fig. 1 legend and Methods: sections cut "1.75 to 2.25 mm from the root tip".
